summary: Two Harbors Investment Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a stockholder lawsuit (Assad v. Two Harbors et al.) in Maryland federal court seeking to enjoin the May 19, 2026 special meeting and the merger with CrossCountry Intermediate Holdco, LLC. The complaint alleges the proxy statement is materially misleading under Sections 14(a) and 20(a) of the Exchange Act. No financial terms, price, or premium were disclosed. The filing cites no board recommendation or break fee. The court may issue a TRO delaying the vote. Watch for corrective disclosures or an injunction ruling; risk-arb spread could widen if regulatory clock pauses.
